Country.evidence_source: Both authors were favorable to the performed validation process among Brazilian young adolescents. Collaboration invitation to the author responsible for the BAS translation into Brazilian Portuguese via e-mail was also carried out.

Survey method.evidence_source: The BAS application was carried out together, in the classroom, by two researchers trained to assist and supervise adolescents in case of any doubts.

Source of sample.evidence_source: The informed consent form was obtained from the student's parents before the data collection. The BAS application was carried out together, in the classroom, by two researchers trained to assist and supervise adolescents in case of any doubts. The process of the BAS items adaptation counted on the collaboration of professionals described above and three students in the 6th year.

Assessment of BA.evidence_source: The researchers requested the permission of the BAS original authors, as well as the Brazilian researcher who conducted the study of the cross-cultural adaptation of BAS, to use this scale. The BAS application was carried out together, in the classroom.

Assessment of BMI.evidence_source: Upon its completion, the collection of anthropometric measurements (weight/height) was performed by the main researcher.

Number of studies.evidence_source: The text describes a single validation process and data collection procedure.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a study involving the cross-cultural adaptation and application of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) among Brazilian young adolescents. It covers obtaining permissions, ethical approval, collaboration for item adaptation, securing informed consent from parents, group administration of the BAS in classrooms, and individual collection of anthropometric measurements (weight/height) by a researcher.
